title: Buildout — Lay the infrastructure. Ship the models.
excerpt: Build your AI infrastructure network. Draft components, connect fiber routes, and deploy models in this strategy game for one to four players.
content_html:
Buildout Strategy

Lay the infrastructure. Ship the models.

Draft components. Match patterns. Deploy your favorite AI models. A strategy game for one to four players.

Rivals:

A fan-made game based on Harmonies by Johan Benvenuto, published by Libellud.
